case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Gardener Interview Name Caption
tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

faults.what: An unrequested circular lettered logo appears even in the opening frame, and an additional banner with garbled lettering appears behind the requested caption, violating the no-other-text requirement.
The requested lower third is positioned across the lower center rather than at the bottom left, overlapping the unwanted banner and creating a cluttered double-caption layout.

judge.summary: The smiling garden portrait and requested wording are present, but an unwanted logo and garbled banner spoil the lower third and require a redo.

must_haves.item: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
must_haves.why: The woman smiles among planted beds and trellises, with her pose changing from angled to more camera-facing across the frames.

must_haves.item: The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
must_haves.why: Both requested lines are exact, but a lettered circular logo and additional garbled banner text are also visible.

must_haves.item: Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
must_haves.why: The requested lines are white, legible, and unclipped on a dark rectangle, but that rectangle is positioned in the lower center instead of the bottom left.

must_haves.item: The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
must_haves.why: The requested caption stays in the same position in the supplied captioned frames and leaves her face unobstructed.

must_haves.item: The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
must_haves.why: The requested caption is absent at 0.9 seconds and present at 2.7, 4.6, and 6.4 seconds, consistent with the requested approximate timing.

must_haves.item: The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are widescreen and the stated duration is 7.3 seconds, but silence cannot be verified from still images.
